Home.kicker: For TikTok Shop creators and affiliates
Home.title: Analyze when to enter TikTok Shop products
Home.tagline: Evaluate when to enter a product before you film.
Home.heroSub: Trending TikTok Shop products, your estimated earnings for each, and the script to say on camera. All in one place.
Home.heroSimulationNoteTitle: Educational simulation, not a TikTok Shop report.
Home.heroSimulationNoteBody: Calculated by the KAIROS engine with a cautious conversion assumption; estimated refunds and product returns are deducted. This is not an individual forecast: always a range, never a guaranteed amount.
Home.tourListCaption: Each row carries the recommendation calculated for that product — not a score to interpret.
Home.tourEarningsCaption: DEMO: amounts are calculated on fictional products and an indicative commission. They are not TikTok commissions retrieved from an affiliate account or a revenue forecast.
Home.tourChartCaption: Sales, shops and creators talking about the product, over the same observed period. This is where you see an opportunity evolve.
Home.tourDisclaimer: DEMO — fictional products. The engines run in your browser to illustrate how it works; in KAIROS, collected data and calculated estimates are always identified separately.
Home.tourScriptCaption: Timed second by second, with the shot list. The « Commercial collaboration » disclosure is written into the script — the same compliance check that protects your videos reviews this one.
Home.paywallDemoBody: The ranking and recommendations are visible for free. This comparison uses demo products and calculates an estimate for 10,000 views: these are not personalized records or a revenue forecast.
Home.paywallLockedHint: Your earnings across all products — Creator plan
Home.paywallFreeNote: With the free plan, the last {count} rows remain visible: you can see that these products exist in the demo and what the engine thinks. Only the amount is hidden.
Home.paywallCreatorNote: The {count} amounts are calculated by the engine for {views} views. Demo products, non-personalized simulation — not a TikTok Shop report.
Home.problemTitle: You post without knowing if you arrived at the right time… or too late.
Home.problemBody: For a product that's taking off, there's a moment when you arrive early enough to be seen, and a moment when the market is already saturated. Nothing on TikTok tells you whether you arrived at the right time — so you film blind, sometimes too early, often too late.
Home.howTitle: Concrete data to decide whether a product deserves a video.
Home.step1Body: Trending TikTok Shop products, with a clear recommendation for each: enter now, enter with an angle, watch, or avoid. The recommendation uses available checks and states what is observed or estimated.
Home.step2Body: Not the seller's revenue or a dream number: your estimated earnings based on your usual views and the product's commission. Estimated refunds and product returns are already deducted.
Home.step3Body: From "I requested the sample" to "it's published", through "received" and "shot". You can see which steps still need action, such as a sample request with no response.
Home.step4Title: Film with the script already written
Home.step4Body: Three hooks to open the video, the shot list, and a second-by-second timed script. A fullscreen mode lets you scroll the script while recording.
Home.feature1Body: Ranked using the available signals: sales trend, competition and the likely duration of the opportunity. Updated as new checks arrive.
Home.feature2Body: Adjust your views and conversion assumption: the amount updates immediately. Estimated refunds and product returns are already deducted. When the commission rate could not be retrieved, the category average is shown next to the number.
Home.feature3Body: Every tracked product until publication, with a reminder when a requested sample never got a reply.
Home.feature4Body: Hooks tailored to when you arrive on the product, the timed script, and a check that what you say complies with French law.
Home.trustTitle: Every number is explained: observed or estimated.
Home.trustBody: Every estimate comes with a range, its data source, and an associated confidence level. When a product does not yet have enough historical data, we say so plainly instead of inventing a reassuring number.
Home.trustPoint1: Always "between X and Y", never a single number
Home.trustPoint2: The estimate's confidence level shown alongside
Home.trustPoint3: Product too new? We say it, not dress it up
Home.plansTitle: Start free, unlock features as you grow.
Home.finalCtaTitle: Check currently trending products before choosing your next one to film.
Home.finalCtaBody: Create your account and explore the available opportunities. No card is required to get started.

Home.verdictsTitle: Four clear recommendations, supported by indicators.
Home.verdictEnterDesc: The product is gaining traction and few creators are positioned yet. It is time to assess a post.
Home.verdictAngleDesc: The product works, but competition is already present. You need a differentiated angle.
Home.verdictRiskDesc: Competition is rising or the signals are still insufficient. Watch it before deciding.
Home.verdictAvoidDesc: Sales are declining, or the product is too new for us to say anything. We'd rather tell you than send you filming for nothing.
Home.faq1Q: Do I need to give my credit card to start?
Home.faq1A: No. The Radar plan is free and no card is required to create an account. You upgrade to Creator or Pro only when you need to.
Home.faq2Q: Is KAIROS an official TikTok or ByteDance partner?
Home.faq2A: No, completely independent. We analyze the TikTok Shop market from public data and manual checks — we are neither a partner nor an official spokesperson.
Home.faq3Q: Where do the numbers come from?
Home.faq3A: From two places, and we don't mix them. Prices, sales and reviews come from public TikTok Shop pages, scraped regularly. Commission rates are not publicly visible: they live in each creator's affiliate area. When nobody has entered them, we show the known category average, preceded by a "~" — never a precise rate we couldn't obtain.
Home.faq4Q: Are my data sold or shared?
Home.faq4A: No. You can export or delete all your data at any time from your account, without having to write to us.
Home.faq5Q: Which TikTok Shop countries is KAIROS available in?
Home.faq5A: TikTok Shop operates market by market. KAIROS currently supports the main available markets — France, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Spain, Austria, Belgium, Netherlands and Poland. Rankings are available only when enough data has been collected for the relevant market.
